samples.summary: Cross-tab undo jump (acceptance criterion 3) is not wired into the shared-link document host, which is editable for non-viewer roles. `SharedSpreadsheet` renders `<SheetView tabId readOnly peerJumpTarget>` with no `onUndoJump`/`undoJumpTarget`, yet `readOnly = resolved.role === "viewer"` (line 198), so an editor following a share link can edit and undo. When their undo replays a step in another tab, `Sheet` fires `onUndoTabJump`, nothing is registered, and the undo lands in the CRDT while appearing to do nothing — exactly the failure the task exists to remove, for that host. The prop doc added in `sheet-view.tsx` justifies the omission as "the read-only share view … undo is disabled", which is inaccurate for the editor role; the shared view also has a tab bar, so the switch is possible there. Either wire the two props in `shared-document.tsx` or record the gap honestly in the doc and in `docs/design/sheets/sheet.md`.
samples.evidence: shared-document.tsx:198 `const readOnly = resolved.role === "viewer";` and :300 `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={readOnly} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` — no undoJumpTarget/onUndoJump; sheet-view.tsx prop comment claims undo is disabled there.
searchedFor: grep 'onUndoJump|undoJumpTarget' across frontend (only document-detail.tsx and sheet-view.tsx)

samples.summary: Selection restoration after a replay is now implemented twice, in two different styles. `Sheet.applyUndoSelection()` hand-sets `selectionType` / `activeCell` / `ranges` for the row and column cases, duplicating `Sheet.selectRow` + `selectRowRange` and `selectColumn` + `selectColumnRange` (sheet.ts:3671-3720) exactly, and hand-normalises the cell case with `normalizeRefToAnchor` / `expandRangeToMergedBoundaries` rather than going through `selectStart` / `selectEnd`. Meanwhile the cross-tab path, `Spreadsheet.focusUndoSelection()`, restores the *same* `UndoSelection` shape by calling those canonical `select*` methods. Same user-visible operation, two implementations that can drift (e.g. a future merge or presence rule added to `selectRow` would apply only after a tab switch). Reusing the existing select API in `applyUndoSelection` would collapse them.
samples.evidence: applyUndoSelection row branch sets `ranges = [[{r:start.r,c:1},{r:end.r,c:this.dimension.columns}]]`, identical to selectRow/selectRowRange at sheet.ts:3671-3706, which focusUndoSelection (spreadsheet.ts) calls instead.

samples.summary: The design-doc section records the mechanism but not the behavioural limits the implementation actually has, which the archived task doc does list: deleting the last row/column reads as a tail truncation and selects cells rather than the header, `conditionalFormats` / `dataValidations` ranges are not recovered, and an undo of a tab add/remove (`$.sheets` / `$.tabs` paths, which `parseSheetPath` rejects) performs no jump. Design docs are the canonical record for this subsystem; limitations kept only in `docs/tasks/archive/**` will not be found by the next reader of `sheet.md`.
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/archive/2026/09/20260917-sheets-undo-selection-todo.md:218-227 'Known limitations'; the new sheet.md section mentions only the no-coordinates case.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. `shared-document.tsx:300` renders `<SheetView tabId readOnly peerJumpTarget>` with neither `undoJumpTarget` nor `onUndoJump`, while `:198` sets `readOnly` only for the `viewer` role, so an editor-role share-link visitor gets a live editable sheet (`sheet-view.tsx:1038` builds a real `YorkieStore`). The shared host also renders its own tab bar (`shared-document.tsx:304-326`), so cross-tab undo is reachable there. `sheet-view.tsx:1082-1084` invokes `onUndoJumpRef.current?.(selection)` with no fallback, and its own comment (`:1079-1081`) states that without this the undo "lands correctly in the CRDT and looks like it did nothing" — exactly the failure the task (`docs/tasks/.../20260917-sheets-undo-selection-todo.md:40,114`) exists to remove. The prop JSDoc's justification (`sheet-view.tsx:162-168`, "the read-only share view … undo is disabled") is factually wrong for the editor role, and `docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:585-590` records only `DocumentLayout` without noting the gap. A repo-wide grep shows only two `<SheetView` call sites (`document-detail.tsx:757` wires both props; `shared-document.tsx:300` does not) and no other reference to `onUndoJump`/`undoJumpTarget` in frontend source, so no counterexample exists. Acceptance criterion left unmet for a real user-facing host: major.
